text: Recently I was contacted by residents, parents and park users around Hideaway Park concerned about pedestrian safety in the alleys that are used by kids and indeed all road users to access the park. Of particular concern was the blind corner at the south-east corner of the park. I was happy to attend a site visit with City Transportation staff, several local parents and other local residents to see this issue for myself. Staff have drafted the language and completed the attached drawings for submission. I am asking that you support my motion to add speed bumps in the surrounding laneways and to add a stop sign to the particularly dangerous south-eastern corner.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the following laneways as shown in Drawing Nos. 421G-3107 and 421G-3108, attached to the Letter (June 25, 2018) from Councillor Paula Fletcher: · First north-south laneway west of Brooklyn Avenue south of Dundas Street East between Audley Avenue and Louvain Avenue · First north-south laneway east of Pape Avenue south of Audley Avenue between Audley Avenue and first east-west laneway east of Pape Avenue south of Blong Avenue · Second east-west laneway south of Audley Avenue east of Pape Avenue 2. Authorized stop control for northbound and southbound traffic in the first north-south laneway west of Brooklyn Avenue and south of Dundas Street East at the second east-west laneway east of Pape Avenue and south of Audley Avenue. 3.
